comment.body: Engineering should investigate why dashboards in the observability beta environment are displaying no metrics post-upgrade. Possible causes include metrics ingestion failures, dashboard configuration changes, or data pipeline issues. Please review logs and recent changes since the upgrade.

Thank you for reporting the metrics display issue in your observability beta environment. Our engineering team is actively investigating the problem and we’ll update you as soon as we have more information.

reply:
I triaged the observability-beta incident per the team triage plan:

- I then added a public acknowledgment to the customer confirming the team is investigating.

No other tickets matched the observability-beta condition or required action under the plan. No protected P0 security tickets were modified. All actions followed the required workflow and privacy constraints.
